verdict.rationale: Crossplane ships an official CLI with its own documentation page. It covers rendering and testing Composition Functions without a cluster, troubleshooting Compositions and Managed Resources, building and pushing packages, and selecting versions or channels via XP_CHANNEL/XP_VERSION. missing for 10: evidence of AI- or agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., machine-readable output or agent workflow docs), in-depth command reference detail, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
